legend: It's that time of the year, Felicity is around the corner and you can see people celebrating all around the Himalayan region. The Himalayan region has n gyms. The i-th gym has gi Pokemon in it. There are m distinct Pokemon types in the Himalayan region numbered from 1 to m. There is a special evolution camp set up in the fest which claims to evolve any Pokemon. The type of a Pokemon could change after evolving, subject to the constraint that if two Pokemon have the same type before evolving, they will have the same type after evolving. Also, if two Pokemon have different types before evolving, they will have different types after evolving. It is also possible that a Pokemon has the same type before and after evolving.
Formally, an evolution plan is a permutation f of {1, 2, ..., m}, such that f(x) = y means that a Pokemon of type x evolves into a Pokemon of type y.

The gym leaders are intrigued by the special evolution camp and all of them plan to evolve their Pokemons. The protocol of the mountain states that in each gym, for every type of Pokemon, the number of Pokemon of that type before evolving any Pokemon should be equal the number of Pokemon of that type after evolving all the Pokemons according to the evolution plan. They now want to find out how many distinct evolution plans exist which satisfy the protocol.
Two evolution plans f1 and f2 are distinct, if they have at least one Pokemon type evolving into a different Pokemon type in the two plans, i. e. there exists an i such that f1(i) ≠ f2(i).

Your task is to find how many distinct evolution plans are possible such that if all Pokemon in all the gyms are evolved, the number of Pokemon of each type in each of the gyms remains the same. As the answer can be large, output it modulo 109 + 7.
input: The first line contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 105, 1 ≤ m ≤ 106) — the number of gyms and the number of Pokemon types.

The next n lines contain the description of Pokemons in the gyms. The i-th of these lines begins with the integer gi (1 ≤ gi ≤ 105) — the number of Pokemon in the i-th gym. After that gi integers follow, denoting types of the Pokemons in the i-th gym. Each of these integers is between 1 and m.
The total number of Pokemons (the sum of all gi) does not exceed 5·105.
output: Output the number of valid evolution plans modulo 109 + 7.

legend.ai: 又到了这个时候，Felicity 即将到来，你可以看到喜庆的人们遍布整个喜马拉雅地区。喜马拉雅地区有 n 个健身房。第 i 个健身房中有 gi 只宝可梦。喜马拉雅地区有 m 种不同的宝可梦类型，编号从 1 到 m。节庆活动中设立了一个特殊的进化营，声称可以使任意宝可梦进化。宝可梦的类型可能会在进化后改变，但需要满足以下约束：如果两只宝可梦在进化前类型相同，那么它们在进化后的类型也相同；如果两只宝可梦在进化前类型不同，那么它们在进化后的类型也不同。宝可梦进化前后的类型也可能相同。
形式化地说，一个进化方案是集合 {1, 2, ..., m} 的一个排列 f，其中 f(x) = y 表示一只类型为 x 的宝可梦会进化为类型为 y 的宝可梦。
道馆馆主们对特殊进化训练营很感兴趣，他们都计划让自己的宝可梦进化。山上的规章规定：对于每个道馆和每种宝可梦，在进行任何宝可梦进化之前，该类型宝可梦的数量应当等于按照进化计划让所有宝可梦进化之后该类型宝可梦的数量。他们现在想知道满足这一规章的不同进化计划共有多少种。
如果两个进化计划 f1 和 f2 至少存在一种宝可梦类型在两个计划中进化成了不同的宝可梦类型，则称它们是不同的。也就是说，存在某个 i，使得 f1(i) ≠ f2(i)。
你的任务是求出所有道馆中的宝可梦都进化后，每个道馆中每种宝可梦的数量都保持不变的不同进化计划数量。由于答案可能很大，请输出答案对 109 + 7 取模的结果。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n ≤ 105，1 ≤ m ≤ 106），分别表示道馆的数量和宝可梦类型的数量。
接下来的 n 行描述各个道馆中的宝可梦。第 i 行首先包含一个整数 gi（1 ≤ gi ≤ 105），表示第 i 个道馆中宝可梦的数量。随后是 gi 个整数，表示该道馆中宝可梦的类型。每个整数都在 1 到 m 之间。
宝可梦的总数量（所有 gi 之和）不超过 5·105。
